answer: Make every new identity lock a refundable stake that only vests after several epochs of passing peer grades. A sybil farm must then tie up capital per fake account. Graders also track the delta between an account's claimed work and its verified output, and a sudden pulse of near-identical answers from fresh keys flags the whole cluster for slashing. Each grade is signed like a quill mark, so colluding graders forfeit their own stake too.
